# Glacius Labs design system 3.0.1

The built CSS and fonts of `@glacius-labs/design-system` 3.0.1, as published on the Glacius Labs GitHub Packages feed (tarball SHA-256 `63c7b26949b2bc0902079547a19a3b5b32a69fc78d41549672a9966baa12bbd7`). Markitect Desktop uses `glacius.css`, which holds the fonts, tokens, icons and components, and the font files it names.

These files are not under Markitect's Apache 2.0 license. The design system is proprietary to Glacius Labs ([LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md)); Glacius Labs allows Markitect to ship it ([DEC-089](../../../docs/concepts/register.md#dec-089-markitect-desktop-the-app-over-the-cli)). The fonts keep the SIL Open Font License (`fonts/LICENSE-*.txt`) and the icons, which `glacius.css` holds as data, the ISC License ([LICENSE-Lucide.txt](LICENSE-Lucide.txt)).

To update, take a released version of the package, replace `glacius.css` and `fonts/`, and update the version and checksum here. Never edit the files.
